questions.question: Starting from the red ball hopper with the solved board configuration, describe the complete path of the first red ball.
questions.answer: The first red ball drops from (8, -1), rolls onto ramp_right at (7, 0), then ramp_right at (8, 1), then ramp_right at (9, 2), then ramp_left at (10, 3), then ramp_left at (9, 4), then ramp_left at (8, 5), then ramp_left at (7, 6), then ramp_left at (6, 7), then ramp_left at (5, 8), then ramp_left at (4, 9), and is caught at the left exit.

questions.question: Which lever does the first red ball trigger and what color ball is released next?
questions.answer: The first red ball triggers the left lever, releasing a blue ball.

questions.question: How many balls total are released and in what order?
questions.answer: 9 balls reach an exit in the order: red exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left, blue exits left. 9 exit left, 0 exit right, 0 are intercepted.
